name: cinemastar-postman-newman
description: Postman/Newman smoke tests for CinemaStar production APIs.

scripts.test:api:prod: newman run CinemaStar.postman_collection.json -e cinema-prod.postman_environment.json --reporters cli,junit,htmlextra --reporter-junit-export reports/junit.xml --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/report.html --timeout-request 20000 --delay-request 100
scripts.test:api:prod:readonly: newman run CinemaStar.postman_collection.json -e cinema-prod.postman_environment.json --folder "ReadOnly Smoke" --reporters cli,junit,htmlextra --reporter-junit-export reports/junit.xml --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/report.html --timeout-request 20000 --delay-request 100
scripts.test:api:prod:mutations: newman run CinemaStar.postman_collection.json -e cinema-prod.postman_environment.json --folder "Mutation Smoke" --env-var RUN_MUTATIONS=true --reporters cli,junit,htmlextra --reporter-junit-export reports/junit-mutations.xml --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/report-mutations.html --timeout-request 20000 --delay-request 100
